{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ozzel family''' was a bloodline hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. They were brought into wealth through the efforts of trading mastermind [[Mann Ozzel]] ages before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Other famous members included [[Ruthbert Ozzel]] and [[Enos Ozzel]].

By the time of the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Ozzel family had done service in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] for centuries and were counted among the [[Generationals]]. 
They maintained a hereditary manse in the [[Sirpar Hills]] on [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] eventually served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], commanding the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].
